_note: Fictional hotel and reviews written for demo and development. Not real guest data.

reviews.text: Personel çok ilgiliydi, resepsiyondaki Ayşe Hanım her sorumuza yardımcı oldu. Kahvaltı çeşidi bol, denize yürüme mesafesi 2 dakika.
Oda temizdi ama gece yan taraftaki bardan gelen müzik yüzünden uyuyamadık. Wi-Fi odada neredeyse hiç çekmiyor.
Fantastic location right on the beach. Staff were warm and remembered our names. Rooms are a bit dated but spotless.
Sehr freundliches Personal und ein tolles Frühstücksbuffet. Das Zimmer war sauber, aber das Badezimmer etwas klein.
Good value for the price, but the pool area gets very crowded and loungers are taken by 8am. Noise from the street at night.
Fiyatına göre gerçekten çok iyi. Temizlik harika, akşam yemekleri lezzetliydi. Tekrar geleceğiz.
Air conditioning broken for two days and nobody fixed it. Front desk was rude when we complained.
Lage direkt am Strand ist unschlagbar. Leider war es nachts wegen der Bars in der Nähe laut. Frühstück gut.
Kids loved the pool and the animation team. Rooms cleaned every day, towels changed. Breakfast had great Turkish options.
Odalar eski ve küf kokuyordu. Wi-Fi sadece lobide çalışıyor. Personel güler yüzlü ama sorunları çözmüyorlar.
Excellent value outside peak season. Quiet in March, friendly staff, decent food. Wi-Fi was slow.
Sauberes Hotel, hilfsbereites Personal, Strand in zwei Minuten erreichbar. Preis-Leistung top.
Location is great but the restaurant food was repetitive after three days. Bathroom needs renovation.
